atlas.name: The Lost Islets
atlas.blurb: The scattered outer islands, mapped from game data rather than a surveyed guide: 849 Aniimo spawn points across 58 species, 441 chests and a handful of rare collectibles, including the Jade-Inlaid Ritual Vessel.

entity.name: Pomegg
entity.description: They retreat into their shells to rest, often getting mistaken for eggs. They fear battle but love a crowd, dancing with grass balls to cheer others on.

entity.name: Iris
entity.description: Iris possesses an extremely lightweight body, often lifted by the wind. It then either slowly spirals downward using the resistance from its petal skirt, or simply allows itself to be carried away by the wind.

entity.name: Susuta
entity.description: They dig around to search for gifts to give to their crushes, but their wooing always fails because they are so shy.

entity.name: Flutternym
entity.description: They are timid and hide whenever they sense danger, but the fluorescent scales they shake off always give them away.

entity.name: Nimbi
entity.description: Don't be surprised to see them floating in the clouds in small groups above the grasslands.

entity.name: Hummin
entity.description: They live on the grassland in groups, they like burrowing for nutrients, and they love singing off-key together!

entity.name: Bolty
entity.description: They live among the trees. When they attack, golden sparks flash from their tails with crackling electric sounds. Agile and quick on their feet, they are very difficult to catch.

entity.name: Bulbly
entity.description: Their first reaction to everything is to escape, and their bulb-like organs indicate whether they are healthy.

entity.name: Shrubclaw
entity.description: The lush plants that cover their shells convert sunlight into nutrients, so they don't even need to eat on sunny days.

entity.name: Wisptis
entity.description: If the only way to evolve is to defeat other Wisptises, then there is no other choice but to keep their claws sharp.

entity.name: Stellarys
entity.description: They prefer solitude and often move through the night. With their starry, cloak-like forms, they resemble mysterious mages and can teleport using psychic energy.

entity.name: Celestis
entity.description: They love food! When they search the forest for food, the glowing stars on their heads are often mistaken for comets. They like hoarding food, adorning their nest with it.

entity.name: Emberpup
entity.description: The lively creatures like to follow Flameruffs around. Once the smoldering fur starts to burn, they thrive.

entity.name: Rookey
entity.description: Despite its imposing size, it is timid and avoids conflict. It finds its courage when friends need protection.

entity.name: Shelly
entity.description: Conceals itself among beach shells using its soft appendages to hold shells in place. Remains sealed during daylight.

entity.name: Thornblade
entity.description: The swords made from thorny stems are drawn only when it's time to protect their pack against enemies.

entity.name: Irisal
entity.description: Devoted to the art of dance, they constantly hone their craft, hoping to share the pure joy and energy of movement.

entity.name: Scorchhowl
entity.description: They enjoy the thrill of the fight since flame and burning mark their growth.

entity.name: Fragrancier
entity.description: They're picky about odors, so they harvest and store various nectar within them to craft unique perfume ingredients.

entity.name: Panpanta
entity.description: They are strong and powerful, but they'd rather stay in their nests and decorate than show off their muscles.

entity.name: Pebbling
entity.description: They are natural geologists who like eating all kinds of minerals. And what they eat determines how they grow.

entity.name: Flamerion
entity.description: They only come out at night and their bodies are made of gaseous energy and can split as they want!

entity.name: Jawling
entity.description: Loves to bite everything it sees. Its flexible jaw can open extremely wide. It shows affection through gentle nibbles.

entity.name: Sparki
entity.description: Though they look like fire, those flames are only flowing energy. They give off no heat at all. In fact, they absorb heat from their surroundings. Sometimes they use this to disguise themselves as campfires and play tricks on others.

entity.name: Pawney
entity.description: Armed with a broken sword and armor, blessed with courage and might, it defends its friends and challenges its foes.

entity.name: Chirpi
entity.description: They often hover at low altitudes, paying attention to every movement on the beach so they won't miss any opportunity.

entity.name: Helmut
entity.description: That tough helmet keeps its squishy body safe, while those extendable mouth-claws help it hunt.

entity.name: Geodeback
entity.description: The minerals they eat will grow back on them with refined energy stored inside.

entity.name: Glacy
entity.description: They are elegant and kind aniimo that always take care of weaker ones, and freeze anyone who crosses them in ice.

entity.name: Flameruff
entity.description: Pack creatures that prize loyalty and unity, these hunters maintain focused, calm eyes that mask their fiery hearts.

entity.name: Tromber
entity.description: They like having fun and producing rhythmic music, so don't be surprised to see a grand symphony.

entity.name: Blazen
entity.description: They use their special fur to capture charged particles in the air to produce and store electricity.

entity.name: Dewy
entity.description: As partners to perfumers, they store and ferment nectar within their bodies, transforming it into perfume ingredients.

entity.name: Ignitis
entity.description: They sharpen their blades and wait for the perfect moment, hiding in the shadows as they toy with their prey. As cold-blooded assassins, they seek to end every fight in a single strike.

entity.name: Minespine
entity.description: Wherever crystal minerals are found, so are they. Their hard spines serve both as protection and as storage for energy.

entity.name: Piopiota
entity.description: Narcissistic little creatures who spend a large amount of time grooming their fur and striking the perfect pose.

entity.name: Pranky
entity.description: They like to stay cool and moist. That's what the layer of film over their bodies is for.

entity.name: Witchin
entity.description: They make bizarre noises to drive intruders to madness, lower their defenses and even cause them to pass out.

entity.name: Budsquire
entity.description: The timid crybabies can also rise up against enemies when cornered. The buds on their heads will blossom as they do so.

entity.name: Luminelle
entity.description: Changes its glow to match its mood while its tentacles create mesmerizing patterns and deliver shocking attacks.

entity.name: Popota
entity.description: They select shells and make them into shovels. It's said that they produce pink bubbles when they see someone they love.

entity.name: Turbo
entity.description: They like to sleep hidden in the clouds, because with the presence of wind pressure and static electricity, the fluffy wool easily attracts things that drift by on the wind.

entity.name: Veilfloat
entity.description: A light-dependent creature that glows when night falls, keeping its light on even while sleeping.

entity.name: Leafy
entity.description: They live among lotus flowers and use their lotus leaf tails to conceal their face and show off their elegant nature.

entity.name: Malevsera
entity.description: They hide their fangs and claws in their soft body. Expert at using their gentle, harmless look to lower other creatures' guard before casually freezing them into ice sculptures.

entity.name: Tuckin
entity.description: They need to absorb nutrients from the soil through their roots to maintain vitality and hate leaving the ground.

entity.name: Jade-Inlaid Ritual Vessel
entity.description: A divine ritual vessel made of bronze and inlaid with precious jade. Ancient Idyllians who lived here used it to worship their Aeons.

entity.name: White Fluffroom
entity.description: White umbrella-shaped mushrooms that grow in branching clusters.
